title: Comment enquiry triage

source.title: Comment moderation
source.demand_evidence: Catalogue presence only; popularity and conversion are unmeasured.

native.messages_text: public "I have sent you a private reply about your request." DM: "{issue_prompt}" After the actual reply, resolve from resolution_policy or hand off; never repeat private details publicly.
native.end_stop: Keyword-requested issue receives private resolution or team handoff; S.
native.difference: Opt-in comment triage, not hiding or deleting comments. Comments remain visible. Do not promise automatic removal.

use_when: People request help through an explicit keyword on selected posts and can discuss the issue privately.
prerequisites: Approve the private issue question and resolution policy; have a team route for unresolved facts.
exclude_when: Do not choose when comments must be hidden/deleted or unwanted comments must be detected semantically. Comments remain visible.
Do not configure when required lifecycle operations are unavailable on the actual host.

inputs.name: campaign
inputs.description: Unique ASCII campaign name, at most 48 characters. Journal belongs to this conversation only.

inputs.name: language
inputs.description: Language for the exact approved messages.

inputs.name: initial_text
inputs.description: Exact approved first message; promised value must be in that message.

inputs.name: refusal_text
inputs.description: Exact approved refusal reply. Ends this campaign before keyword matching.

inputs.name: handoff_text
inputs.description: Exact approved team reply; native handoff needs separate readback.

inputs.name: post_ids
inputs.description: Actual owned Instagram posts; inspect overlap before preparation.

inputs.name: keyword
inputs.description: Approved entry word; read actual host matching rules.

inputs.name: public_text
inputs.description: Exact approved public copy, or nonempty inactive copy when public replies are disabled.

inputs.name: resolution_policy
inputs.description: Approved facts and resolution boundaries. Unknown facts go to the team.

inputs.name: issue_prompt
inputs.description: Exact approved private invitation to explain the issue.

steps.action: Actual matching keyword comment on the selected post.
Send the exact approved first message. Deliver any promised value now.
Stated outcome only. No inferred booking, registration, purchase, verified follow or verified share.
public "I have sent you a private reply about your request." DM: "{issue_prompt}" After the actual reply, resolve from resolution_policy or hand off; never repeat private details publicly.
End this campaign on refusal. Do not restart from a keyword in the refusal.
Send nothing for silence or external clicks; enforce current delivery windows.
Same-run repeat does not restart intake, resend a bonus or duplicate capture. Ambiguous late replies need clarification.
Use native team handoff on person request, unresolved facts or approved handoff criteria. Text alone is not handoff proof.

Actual contact reply within the current window. No silent continuation.
Approved factual resolution or appropriate contextual thanks.
No inbound reply, or only an external click.
Refusal completed. No permanent cross-source suppression claimed.

reconciliation.explanation: Keep the older literal-source contract and its unavailable/unverified status unchanged. This described outcome replaces its mechanism and does not inherit its evidence.

operations: Read actual host tools and get_playbook for this recipe.
Create/bind only an approved owned OFF rule. Normal setup_comment_replies is not draft preparation.

Apply native policy mode C; inspect actual inputs before writes.

Apply native policy mode H; inspect actual inputs before writes.
Read back each exact setting and inheritance before continuing.
configuration.normal_connector_gate: Required OFF creation, exact inheritance restoration or continuing comment preview may be unavailable. Stop before writes; a documented GraphQL alternative is not an available normal tool.

lifecycle.return: Use this conversation journal and fresh native readback. No cross-chat state or user settings transfer. If the journal is missing, read-only reconciliation only.
lifecycle.stop: Apply S from native-policy.md: safe owned disable; exact campaign additions only; preserve concurrent changes and inheritance. Restore dormant Send only after original OFF DM is OFF. Read back every stop; live silence is separate.
lifecycle.restart: Fresh source and consent, same verified ownership. Waitlist membership stays joined/withdrawn; no old consent reuse.

preview.note: Older previews do not establish unchanged behavior after prompt changes.

live.note: Earlier core delivery/handoff reported separately; full lifecycle and exact current recipe revision not accepted.

acceptance.note: Zero versions qualify. Local checks, previews and partial live paths are not acceptance.
